name: Glittering Meadows
arrivalText: The scent of wild lavender and sweet clover fills the air as you step onto the shimmering fields of Glittering Meadows.
description: A sun-drenched pasture of wildflowers, copper veins, and wild flax. A peaceful area, though slimes and young wolves roam the hills.
visualTheme: Sun-drenched meadows perched on a grassy ridge, overlooking rolling pastures of wild clover.

history.createdWhy: Formed naturally along the fertile floodplains of Oakhaven.
history.majorEvents: Initially cleared of territorial wolves during the hamlet's founding.
history.whyExists: Acts as the primary grazing meadows and basic mining grounds.
history.currentConflicts: Wood sprites have turned defensive due to the nearby goblin outpost activities.
